evidence.reference_title: Rare MPIG6B Gene Mutation in an Indian Male with Anemia and Thrombocytopenia.
evidence.snippet: The anemia in this case was related to the MPIG6B gene mutation and it did not improve with romiplostim.

nodes.description: JAK1 and JAK2 inhibitor, given to a 9-year-old boy for splenomegaly when transplantation was deferred for lack of a donor. Over three months the spleen shrank from 8 cm to 4 cm below the costal margin and the haemoglobin rose, and he stayed on it for more than a year. This is a single patient with no post-treatment marrow assessment, and the drug is not established for this disease.

evidence.reference_title: A Novel MPIG6B Gene Variant Identified in a Patient with Congenital Thrombocytopenia from Türkiye.
evidence.snippet: Ruxolitinib (5 mg twice daily) was initiated to reduce splenomegaly.

evidence.reference_title: A Novel MPIG6B Gene Variant Identified in a Patient with Congenital Thrombocytopenia from Türkiye.
evidence.snippet: After 3 months, spleen size had decreased from 8 cm to 4 cm, hemoglobin had improved to 9-10 g/dL

nodes.description: Spleen removal, used in a few patients. In one man splenectomised at four years of age the platelet count normalised afterwards, and he was not reassessed until he presented with myelodysplastic syndrome at 42.

evidence.reference_title: ASXL2 mutated myelodysplastic syndrome in a novel germline G6b variant.
evidence.snippet: At age 4 years he was found to have splenomegaly and thrombocytopenia and underwent splenectomy after which his platelet concentration normalized.

nodes.description: Splenic enlargement, reported in most patients and progressive. One patient's spleen measured 125 mm on ultrasound; another was palpable 8 cm below the costal margin and shrank to 4 cm on ruxolitinib.

evidence.reference_title: A Rare MPIG6B Gene Mutation in a Saudi Adolescent Male With Thrombocytopenia, Anemia, and Myelofibrosis: A Case Report.
evidence.snippet: An ultrasound of the abdomen and pelvis revealed an enlarged spleen with a span measuring 125 mm

evidence.reference_title: MPIG6B-related thrombocytopenia and myelofibrosis: A case report.
evidence.snippet: Abdominal examination demonstrated mild splenomegaly without hepatomegaly or tenderness.

nodes.description: Not every patient has large platelets. In a Kurdish family homozygous for a missense allele, the platelet count was persistently low from the third day of life while the mean platelet volume stayed normal, and two affected relatives had isolated thrombocytopenia with no anemia, splenomegaly or fibrosis.

evidence.reference_title: A Novel MPIG6B Gene Variant Identified in a Patient with Congenital Thrombocytopenia from Türkiye.
evidence.snippet: Platelet counts remained persistently low while mean platelet volume was normal (8-9 fL)

nodes.description: Without the ITIM brake, Syk activity downstream of the ITAM-bearing collagen receptor complex GPVI-FcR gamma-chain runs high, megakaryocytes produce more metalloproteinase, and surface receptors including GPVI and GPIb alpha are shed. That receptor loss is the proximate cause of the platelets' collagen hyporesponsiveness, and reducing Syk activity genetically rescues both the platelet count and the receptor levels in mice.

animal_models.description: Receptor-null megakaryocytes show the raised Syk activity, the metalloproteinase-driven shedding and the loss of GPVI that this node asserts, and lowering Syk activity genetically reverses them.
animal_models.name: Mpig6b-null mouse

biological_processes: metalloproteinase-mediated shedding of platelet surface receptors

evidence.reference_title: Treatment of congenital thrombocytopenia and decreased collagen reactivity in G6b-B-deficient mice.
evidence.snippet: Platelets are almost completely devoid of the glycoprotein VI (GPVI)-FcRγ-chain collagen receptor complex

evidence.reference_title: Treatment of congenital thrombocytopenia and decreased collagen reactivity in G6b-B-deficient mice.
evidence.snippet: Syk loss-of-function (R41A) rescued macrothrombocytopenia, GPVI and α2β1 expression in G6b KO mice

nodes.description: Missense allele found homozygous in three members of a consanguineous Kurdish family from Türkiye, classified as a variant of uncertain significance on allele frequency alone and supported by segregation. The three homozygotes differ markedly in severity, from isolated thrombocytopenia to progressive fibrosis.

evidence.reference_title: A Novel MPIG6B Gene Variant Identified in a Patient with Congenital Thrombocytopenia from Türkiye.
evidence.snippet: Whole-exome sequencing identified a novel homozygous MPIG6B variant (NM_001282584.3.103T>C; p.Cys35Arg)

evidence.reference_title: A Novel MPIG6B Gene Variant Identified in a Patient with Congenital Thrombocytopenia from Türkiye.
evidence.snippet: Despite carrying the same homozygous variant, these relatives exhibited isolated thrombocytopenia (20,000-80,000/mm3) without anemia, splenomegaly, or fibrosis, indicating marked intrafamilial phenotypic variability.

nodes.description: Nonsense allele found homozygous in a 21-year-old Indian man with persistent anemia, thrombocytopenia, giant platelets and grade 1 marrow fibrosis who responded to romiplostim.

evidence.reference_title: Rare MPIG6B Gene Mutation in an Indian Male with Anemia and Thrombocytopenia.
evidence.snippet: A whole-exome sequence showed a homozygous loss-of-function mutation in MPIG6B: c.132G>A (p.Trp44Ter).

nodes.description: Nonsense allele reported homozygous in the four Kuwaiti siblings of the founding family and in a 31-year-old Jordanian man, in whom it was the second reported instance. The truncated protein is destabilized.

evidence.reference_title: Novel G6B gene variant causes familial autosomal recessive thrombocytopenia and anemia.
evidence.snippet: We also showed the p.C108* mutation was responsible for destabilizing the encoded truncated G6B protein.

evidence.reference_title: MPIG6B Gene-Related Myelofibrosis: A Rare Inherited Disease That Is Frequently Described in Arab Population.
evidence.snippet: revealed a pathogenic homozygous mutation in MPIG6B gene c.324C > A (p.Cys108Ter) located on exon 2

nodes.description: Nonsense allele reported homozygous in four Chinese patients, including a 14-year-old girl cured by matched unrelated donor transplantation and a 26-year-old man with grade 3 marrow fibrosis born to non-consanguineous parents.

evidence.reference_title: A novel MPIG6B gene mutation in an adolescent girl with congenital thrombocytopenia and myelofibrosis.
evidence.snippet: We have added to this database by reporting a new homozygous nonsense mutation (c.420T>A(p.Tyr140Ter)) of MPIG6B in a 14-year-old girl who presented with pallor

nodes.description: Nonsense allele reported homozygous in a 10-month-old girl and in a 13-year-old Saudi boy with anemia, thrombocytopenia, splenomegaly and focal marrow fibrosis.

evidence.reference_title: A Rare MPIG6B Gene Mutation in a Saudi Adolescent Male With Thrombocytopenia, Anemia, and Myelofibrosis: A Case Report.
evidence.snippet: The WES study identified a homozygous variant c.523C>T in the MPIG6B gene
